## Vireo 0.9.3
Vireo 0.9.3 makes Inkling 2 Mini much faster, remembers its chats, and adds a smaller version of it for Macs with 32 GB of memory.
### Inkling 2 Mini
- **About twice as fast at reading, and quicker to write.** Syrinx's Inkling code was tuned throughout. On a MacBook Pro with M5 Max, Inkling 2 Mini now reads a prompt at about 2,950 tokens a second and writes about 65 tokens a second with 8K of context (0.9.2: about 1,450 and 50). Long chats gain the most. - **A drafter for faster replies.** Vireo now downloads Inkling's small DSpark drafter (400 MB) with the model. It guesses the next few words and Inkling checks them all at once, so code and text copied from earlier in the chat are written about 25–40% faster. Every word is still Inkling's own choice, and when the guesses stop paying off Vireo writes without them. If you installed Inkling 2 Mini with 0.9.2, choose **Get drafter** next to it in Settings › Models. - **Chats pick up where they left off.** Inkling chats are now saved like Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 chats, so going back to an earlier one loads it in a fraction of a second instead of reading the whole conversation again. New chats also start sooner, because Vireo keeps its instructions and tools ready instead of reading them again each time. - **A smaller version for 32 GB Macs.** Inkling 2 Mini (smaller) is the 4-bit IQ4_NL version: a 17.6 GB download that writes short replies about 20% faster than the full Q8_0 version and scores almost the same in our tests. It's in Settings › Models, and Inkling's version picker now offers it too.
### Good to know
- Pictures still can't be attached to a chat. Vireo's engine is learning to see images; it isn't in this version yet. - The drafter is for Inkling 2 Mini only. Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 keep using their own ways of guessing ahead, as before.
Everything else in [0.9.2](https://github.com/InvurseStudio/Vireo-app/releases/tag/v0.9.2) is unchanged.
### Requirements
A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later. Inkling 2 Mini needs 48 GB of memory or more; its smaller version, 32 GB.
